styles: 100 BPM, D minor, steady tempo all the way through
huge tribal war drums with a pounding drum kit
brutal low baritone sax, trumpet and growling trombone blasts, dark Afro-funk
raw dry live band recording in one room

sections.text:
[Intro]
{tribal war drums pound alone and a distorted guitar riff joins, building the groove}

[Verse]
{drums and fuzz bass lock a tight driving groove with short palm-muted guitar stabs, the horns rest}

[Chorus]
{the whole band at full force, brass blasts over a wall of distorted guitars, crashing cymbals}

[Break]
{stop-time: the whole band slams one chord together on beat one of each bar and lets it ring, silence between the hits}
styles: drums and bass drop out between hits
